import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define the region (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho)
# Approximate bounding box for these three countries
namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[11.5, -17.5], [25.3, -17.5], [25.3, -29], [11.5, -29], [11.5, -17.5]]])
botswana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[19.9, -17.8], [29.4, -17.8], [29.4, -26.9], [19.9, -26.9], [19.9, -17.8]]])
lesotho = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[27, -28.5], [29.5, -28.5], [29.5, -30.7], [27, -30.7], [27, -28.5]]])
region = ee.Geometry.MultiPolygon([namibia, botswana, lesotho])

# 2. Get CHIRPS precipitation data
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')

# 3. Calculate Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 total rainfall
target_period = chirps.filter(ee.Filter.date('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01'))
if target_period.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for Dec 2018 - Jan 2019")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    target_rain = target_period.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # 4. Calculate long-term average for Dec+Jan (2000-2019)
    # For each year from 2000 to 2019, sum Dec+Jan rainfall
    years = list(range(2000, 2020))
    yearly_totals = []
    
    for year in years:
        dec_jan = chirps.filter(ee.Filter.date(f'{year}-12-01', f'{year+1}-02-01'))
        if dec_jan.size().getInfo() > 0:
            total = dec_jan.select('precipitation').sum()
            yearly_totals.append(total)
    
    if len(yearly_totals) == 0:
        print("No long-term data available")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate mean of all yearly totals
        long_term_avg = ee.ImageCollection(yearly_totals).mean()
        
        # 5. Calculate regional mean rainfall
        target_mean = target_rain.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=region,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        long_term_mean = long_term_avg.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=region,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        # Check for valid results
        if target_mean is None or long_term_mean is None:
            print("Calculation failed - null results")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif target_mean < 0 or long_term_mean < 0:
            print("Invalid negative precipitation")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Dec2018-Jan2019: {target_mean:.2f} mm")
            print(f"Long-term avg (2000-2019): {long_term_mean:.2f} mm")
            print(f"Years analyzed: {len(yearly_totals)}")
            
            if target_mean < long_term_mean:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
